interpretation: This independent retry satisfies the functional GP9 boot-recovery gate: while the jumper was held, the device reported source bit 9 (mask 512) and forced_recovery=true; after release it reported mask 0 while forced_recovery remained true. The target PnP node disappeared and returned, and the held/released full CDC snapshots preserved the same saved configuration and profiles. This supports proceeding to the separately reviewed IO4 mode procedure under its runtime identity/revision gates. It does not establish electrical health after the earlier short circuit, hardware Flash capacity, HID report-byte delivery, physical IO4 inputs, or game behavior. The first failed GP9 attempt remains valid separate evidence and was not replaced.
